description: Set up the proxy layer architecture for Polymarket API calls
steps: Create src/prediction_data/api/polymarket_proxy/ directory
Create polymarket_client.py with httpx async client
Add POLYMARKET_CLOB_URL and POLYMARKET_GAMMA_URL to settings
Implement request retry logic with exponential backoff
Add rate limiting to stay under Polymarket limits (see CLAUDE.md)
Create response caching layer with configurable TTL
Add circuit breaker for Polymarket API failures

description: Proxy the Polymarket CLOB timeseries endpoint
steps: Create GET /api/v1/proxy/markets/{token_id}/timeseries endpoint
Reference: https://docs.polymarket.com/developers/CLOB/timeseries
Map query params: interval (1m,5m,15m,1h,6h,1d), fidelity (1-60)
Proxy to GET https://clob.polymarket.com/prices-history
Transform response to our PriceHistoryResponse schema
Cache responses: 1m interval=30s TTL, 1h interval=5m TTL, 1d interval=1h TTL
Add startTs and endTs param support for date range filtering

description: Proxy the Polymarket CLOB order book endpoint
steps: Create GET /api/v1/proxy/markets/{token_id}/orderbook endpoint
Reference: https://docs.polymarket.com/developers/CLOB/l2-order-book
Proxy to GET https://clob.polymarket.com/book
Return bids and asks arrays with price/size
Calculate and include spread (best ask - best bid)
Cache responses with 5s TTL (order book is volatile)
Add depth parameter to limit levels returned (default 10)

description: Proxy the Polymarket top holders endpoint
steps: Create GET /api/v1/proxy/markets/{token_id}/top-holders endpoint
Reference: https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/core/get-top-holders-for-markets
Proxy to GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/top-holders
Pass through token_id and limit params
Transform response to our TopHoldersResponse schema
Cache responses with 5m TTL
Return wallet address, position size, and value

description: Proxy the Polymarket trades endpoint for activity feed
steps: Create GET /api/v1/proxy/markets/{token_id}/trades endpoint
Reference: https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/core/get-trades-for-a-user-or-markets
Proxy to GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/trades
Support params: limit, before (cursor), maker, asset_id
Transform response to our RecentTradesResponse schema
Cache responses with 30s TTL
Include trade id, price, size, side, timestamp, maker address

description: Proxy market info for real-time price and volume
steps: Create GET /api/v1/proxy/markets/{condition_id} endpoint
Reference: https://docs.polymarket.com/developers/CLOB/the-clob-api
Proxy to GET https://clob.polymarket.com/markets/{condition_id}
Return current prices, 24h volume, liquidity
Cache with 10s TTL for semi-real-time updates
Fall back to our dim_market data if CLOB unavailable

description: Handle mapping between our IDs and Polymarket token IDs
steps: Create helper to get token_id from our market_id
Query dim_outcome for clob_token_id field
Cache token_id mappings in memory (they don't change)
Handle both Yes and No token IDs for binary markets
Add error handling for markets without token IDs
Create utility endpoint GET /api/v1/markets/{id}/tokens to expose mappings

description: Implement robust error handling for proxy layer
steps: Return 502 Bad Gateway on Polymarket API failures
Return 429 if we hit Polymarket rate limits (with Retry-After)
Log all proxy errors with request context
Return cached stale data on transient failures (if available)
Add health check that pings Polymarket endpoints
Create ProxyError exception class with upstream details
Use Redis if available (docker profile cache), else in-memory
Create cache key format: polymarket:{endpoint}:{params_hash}
Implement cache-aside pattern with TTL
Add cache hit/miss metrics logging
Support cache invalidation by pattern
Add X-Cache header to responses (HIT/MISS/STALE)

description: Create React hooks for consuming proxy endpoints
steps: Create useTimeseries(tokenId, interval) hook
Create useOrderbook(tokenId) hook with refetch interval
Create useTopHolders(tokenId, limit) hook
Create useMarketTrades(tokenId, limit) hook
Create useMarketPrice(conditionId) hook for real-time price
Add proper TypeScript types for all hook responses
Configure React Query staleTime to match backend cache TTL
